name: The Rookie: Feds
s: In The Rookie: Feds , Simone Clark is a force of nature, the living embodiment of a dream deferred - and the oldest rookie in the FBI Academy. Spin-off of The Rookie .

paragraphs.text: The Rookie: Feds is an American police procedural television series and spin-off of The Rookie. Created by Alexi Hawley and Terence Paul Winter for ABC, the series follows Simone Clark, the oldest rookie in the FBI Academy. Niecy Nash-Betts, Felix Solis, Frankie Faison, Britt Robertson, Kevin Zegers, and James Lesure were cast in starring roles. The basic premise of the series and its characters were introduced through a two-episode backdoor pilot in The Rookie. It aired from September 27, 2022, to May 2, 2023.
